other_conditions: Applicant must be a native of Rajasthan
Applicant must be an ex‑serviceman who served during World War II (1 September 1939 to 15 August 1945) or his widow
Applicant must not be receiving any pension or financial assistance from any other source
benefits_summary: Lifelong pension of ₹15,000 per month deposited directly into the beneficiary’s bank account.
